name: YTS
description: YTS movies and TV shows with full quality tiers (720p / 1080p / 2160p), seeders and sizes. Every link is a magnet, so playback is resolved through your Torrin / TorBox / Real-Debrid account (Settings > Player > Debrid). Sites in this family move domains often, so this plugin is standalone and can be pointed at a new mirror without touching the others.
